Which type of battery had the highest total sales over the last seven years?
solution:
**Solution:**

Total sales of 4AH battery over the last seven years = 75 + 90 + 96 + 105 + 90 + 105 + 115 = 676

Total sales of 7AH battery over the last seven years = 144 + 126 + 114 + 90 + 75 + 60 + 85 = 694

Total sales of 32AH battery over the last seven years = 114 + 102 + 75 + 150 + 135 + 165 + 160 = 901

Total sales of 35AH battery over the last seven years = 102 + 84 + 105 + 90 + 75 + 45 + 100 = 601

Total sales of 55AH battery over the last seven years = 108 + 126 + 135 + 75 + 90 + 120 + 145 = 799

∴ Battery had the highest total sales over the last seven years is 32AH.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
